scenarios.hypothesis: A local proxy upgrades to a candidate implementation whose changed storage slot/type semantics reinterpret an existing bounded synthetic value under the wrong field meaning.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A controlled local test chain uses synthetic proxy state and a read-only getter to compare the same storage slot before and after the upgrade without moving real assets.
scenarios.positive_control: An otherwise identical candidate implementation with a compatible storage layout preserves the synthetic value and semantic field meaning after the upgrade commit.
scenarios.negative_control: Reading the candidate implementation instance directly does not reproduce the proxy-storage interpretation, proving the oracle distinguishes implementation storage from proxy context.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop immediately if validation would require production admin/governance keys, a live proposal or deployment, real assets, public protocol state changes, or leaving the owned local test chain.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After restoring storage-layout compatibility or an explicit migration, replay from the same snapshot preserves the intended proxy value semantics and compatible controls remain unchanged.
scenarios.proxy_implementation_governance_generati: Record proxy/deployment generation, current and candidate implementation generations, implementation code revisions, synthetic admin identity, and governance operation generation.
scenarios.upgrade_authorization_commit_trace: Bind the authorized local upgrade operation, implementation slot or registry write, migration call if any, exact activation point, and post-upgrade active implementation generation.
scenarios.storage_layout_state_interpretation: Capture storage layout versions, exact slot/offset/type/packing, pre-upgrade semantic owner and value, candidate semantic owner, post-upgrade interpretation, and first proxy consumer.
scenarios.initializer_reinitializer_migration_stat: Record initializer/version state and any migration generation so the wrong field interpretation cannot be attributed to an unrelated initializer or intended migration.
scenarios.selector_fallback_beacon_facet_state: Keep selector/fallback routing fixed and record the same getter selector and delegate target before/after upgrade to isolate storage interpretation from routing changes.
scenarios.upgrade_invariant_bounded_consequence: Bind the storage-preservation invariant to the commit point and show one bounded synthetic field is interpreted incorrectly without inferring protocol-wide loss.
scenarios.downstream_proxy_consumer_identity: Identify the read-only proxy getter or local consumer that interprets the changed slot under candidate code and emits the deterministic before/after receipt.
scenarios.effective_upgradeability_capability: The demonstrated capability is limited to one reversible local proxy-state interpretation mismatch introduced by an incompatible candidate storage layout.
scenarios.bounded_result: The bounded result is a read-only local receipt containing implementation generations, slot/type identity, pre/post values, and no live or financial effect.
scenarios.receipt_result_binding: Correlate chain reset, proxy, implementations, upgrade transaction, layout generations, slot identity, getter consumer, observed interpretation, and receipt deterministically.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Hold proxy snapshot, admin, candidate behavior, selector, and upgrade operation constant while changing only incompatible versus compatible storage-layout semantics.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Reject intended migration semantics, implementation-instance reads, different proxy snapshot, different candidate code hash, routing change, reverted upgrade, or receipt from another generation.
scenarios.evidence_level: SCU4 because a reversible synthetic proxy-state effect is causally bound to the exact storage-layout mismatch introduced by the committed local upgrade.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: SCU4 maximum until complete governance/migration provenance, alternative elimination, remediation replay, and regression evidence satisfy the SCU5 contract.

scenarios.hypothesis: A local proxy upgrade leaves initialized-version state inconsistent so the same bounded synthetic reinitializer transition can execute again or under the wrong implementation generation.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A local test chain uses a synthetic initialization counter and read-only initialized-version snapshot; no real authority, token balance, or external system is affected.
scenarios.positive_control: A correctly versioned candidate implementation permits the intended one-time reinitializer exactly once and records the expected synthetic initialized-version marker.
scenarios.negative_control: A second call after the correctly guarded reinitializer is rejected and leaves the synthetic counter and initialized-version state unchanged.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop immediately if validation would require production admin/governance keys, a live proposal or deployment, real assets, public protocol state changes, or leaving the owned local test chain.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After binding reinitializer guards to the correct initialized-version generation, replay allows the intended transition once and rejects repeated or stale-generation calls.
scenarios.proxy_implementation_governance_generati: Record proxy generation, old/new implementation generations, candidate code revision, synthetic admin generation, and the local upgrade operation activating the candidate.
scenarios.upgrade_authorization_commit_trace: Capture the authorized local upgrade commit, candidate activation, optional upgrade-and-call path, and exact transaction generations for first and repeated reinitializer attempts.
scenarios.storage_layout_state_interpretation: Record the initialized-version storage location and synthetic counter layout before/after upgrade to exclude accidental slot reinterpretation as the replay cause.
scenarios.initializer_reinitializer_migration_stat: Bind initializer/reinitializer identity, version guard, initialized-version state before/after, caller, migration generation, first state writes, and repeated invocation result.
scenarios.selector_fallback_beacon_facet_state: Keep reinitializer selector routing and delegate target fixed across controls so the case isolates version-state binding rather than selector or facet drift.
scenarios.upgrade_invariant_bounded_consequence: Bind the one-time/versioned initialization invariant to a bounded synthetic counter marker and the post-commit proxy state after each invocation.
scenarios.downstream_proxy_consumer_identity: Identify the read-only proxy state consumer that observes initialized-version and synthetic counter changes and emits a transaction-tagged receipt.
scenarios.effective_upgradeability_capability: The demonstrated capability is limited to repeating or mis-versioning one inert local initializer transition under inconsistent initialized-version state.
scenarios.bounded_result: The bounded result is a reversible synthetic initialization marker with version/transaction receipts and no production ownership, funds, or governance consequence.
scenarios.receipt_result_binding: Correlate proxy, implementation generation, upgrade commit, reinitializer version, caller, first/repeated transactions, state snapshots, consumer, and receipt deterministically.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Hold proxy state, candidate implementation, caller, selector, and operation constant while changing only stale/inconsistent versus correct initialized-version binding.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Reject an intentionally callable newer reinitializer version, different proxy instance, direct implementation invocation, layout corruption, reverted transaction, or another candidate revision.
scenarios.evidence_level: SCU4 because a bounded synthetic initialization-state effect is causally bound to inconsistent reinitializer version state after the local upgrade.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: SCU4 maximum until complete upgrade/migration provenance, alternative elimination, deterministic remediation replay, and regression evidence satisfy SCU5.

scenarios.hypothesis: A local selector-table or facet-set upgrade maps an inert function selector to a different synthetic facet than the documented target for the current routing generation.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A fake local diamond/proxy uses inert facet markers and a read-only routing receipt to identify the selected target without external calls, funds, or privileged effects.
scenarios.positive_control: The intended selector-table generation routes the same inert selector to the documented synthetic facet and returns the expected fixed marker.
scenarios.negative_control: An unrelated selector remains bound to its documented facet across both generations, proving the harness is not globally misrouting all calls.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop immediately if validation would require production admin/governance keys, a live proposal or deployment, real assets, public protocol state changes, or leaving the owned local test chain.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After correcting selector ownership or facet-set generation, the target selector resolves to the documented facet while unrelated selector controls remain stable.
scenarios.proxy_implementation_governance_generati: Record proxy/diamond generation, facet-set generation, candidate facet identities/code revisions, synthetic admin/governance generation, and routing-update operation.
scenarios.upgrade_authorization_commit_trace: Bind the local authorized facet/selector update, selector-table commit generation, activation point, and final active facet-set receipt.
scenarios.storage_layout_state_interpretation: Keep bounded storage state unchanged and record that no storage-layout or migration difference participates, isolating the selector-routing generation.
scenarios.initializer_reinitializer_migration_stat: Record no initializer/reinitializer change or keep its state identical across controls so initialization cannot explain the wrong target.
scenarios.selector_fallback_beacon_facet_state: Capture selector value, old/new selector-table generations, intended and actual facet identities, fallback rules, delegate context, and final inert marker consumer.
scenarios.upgrade_invariant_bounded_consequence: Bind the routing invariant to the exact selector at the committed facet-set generation and limit consequence to one inert wrong-target marker.
scenarios.downstream_proxy_consumer_identity: Identify the proxy/diamond dispatcher and synthetic facet consumer that returns the marker, with a receipt naming selector and facet-set generation.
scenarios.effective_upgradeability_capability: The demonstrated capability is limited to one inert selector reaching an unintended synthetic local facet after a committed routing-table upgrade.
scenarios.bounded_result: The bounded result is a read-only routing receipt containing selector, intended/actual facets, facet-set generation, and no external or financial effect.
scenarios.receipt_result_binding: Correlate proxy/diamond, selector, governance operation, facet-set generations, active routing table, delegate target, marker result, and receipt deterministically.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Hold proxy snapshot, selector, caller, facet code, and dispatcher constant while changing only conflicting versus corrected selector-table generation.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Reject documented selector reassignment, admin-special routing, fallback behavior, different selector encoding, uncommitted facet update, or receipt from another facet-set generation.
scenarios.evidence_level: SCU3 because a read-only inert proxy consumer deterministically reaches the wrong synthetic facet under the committed selector-routing generation.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: SCU3 maximum until a bounded reversible protocol-state effect plus complete routing/governance provenance and remediation replay justify SCU4 or SCU5.

scenarios.hypothesis: A local rollback restores the prior implementation code while leaving state written by the newer migration in a generation incompatible with the restored implementation semantics.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A controlled local test chain uses bounded synthetic migration markers and read-only getters before upgrade, after migration, and after rollback; no real assets or live governance are involved.
scenarios.positive_control: A rollback path that includes compatible reverse migration or state restoration returns both implementation code and synthetic state semantics to the documented prior generation.
scenarios.negative_control: A forward upgrade with no rollback keeps the migrated state under the implementation generation designed to consume it and satisfies the local compatibility invariant.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop immediately if validation would require production admin/governance keys, a live proposal or deployment, real assets, public protocol state changes, or leaving the owned local test chain.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After coupling rollback with compatible state restoration or disallowing unsafe downgrade, replay restores code and state generations consistently while forward-upgrade controls remain valid.
scenarios.proxy_implementation_governance_generati: Record proxy generation, prior/candidate/restored implementation generations, code revisions, synthetic governance operations, upgrade and rollback transaction generations.
scenarios.upgrade_authorization_commit_trace: Capture forward upgrade commit, migration activation, rollback/downgrade authorization and commit, final implementation slot/registry state, and activation receipts.
scenarios.storage_layout_state_interpretation: Bind pre-upgrade and migrated storage semantics to the restored implementation layout, identifying any field whose migrated generation is incompatible after rollback.
scenarios.initializer_reinitializer_migration_stat: Record forward migration identity/state writes, rollback migration or absence, initialized-version state, migration generations, and replay behavior.
scenarios.selector_fallback_beacon_facet_state: Keep selector routing stable or record equivalent routing generations so post-rollback semantic mismatch is not attributed to a different dispatcher target.
scenarios.upgrade_invariant_bounded_consequence: Bind the rollback compatibility invariant to one bounded synthetic state marker and show restored code consumes state from an incompatible migration generation.
scenarios.downstream_proxy_consumer_identity: Identify the read-only restored-implementation getter/consumer that interprets the retained migrated state and emits the post-rollback compatibility receipt.
scenarios.effective_upgradeability_capability: The demonstrated capability is limited to one reversible local rollback state-generation mismatch between restored code and retained migrated state.
scenarios.bounded_result: The bounded result is a local receipt comparing implementation and state generations before upgrade, after migration, and after rollback with no live-value consequence.
scenarios.receipt_result_binding: Correlate proxy, forward/rollback operations, implementation generations, migration generations, storage snapshot, restored consumer result, and receipt deterministically.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Hold proxy, prior/candidate code, caller, and rollback operation constant while changing only retained migrated state versus compatible reverse migration/state restoration.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Reject intentional backward-compatible migration, different restored code revision, selector drift, direct implementation reads, failed rollback commit, or another proxy snapshot.
scenarios.evidence_level: SCU4 because a reversible local rollback effect is causally bound to restored implementation code consuming state from an incompatible migration generation.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: SCU4 maximum until complete rollback/governance/layout provenance, alternative elimination, remediation replay, and regression evidence satisfy SCU5.
